description: Register a local home-services business in the network so homeowner agents can find it and send job requests. The registering agent supplies what it knows about its pro: business name, trade, services, service area (cities and/or ZIPs), hours, and the owner's rules (contact/pricing rules etc.). If the business has its own agent endpoint (e.g. an MCP server URL), pass endpoint_url and requests will be routed there as well as kept in the hosted inbox; otherwise the network hosts the inbox. Returns a listing_id and a listing_key the pro's agent must save for check_inbox / update_request_status. New listings start unverified. This network carries no prices — never put prices in any field.

endpoint_url.description: Optional: the business's own agent endpoint URL for request routing.

rules.description: The owner's rules for requests: how to qualify, what contact info to collect, pricing policy, etc.

name: register_business
